text:
Lina Gomez: quick heads-up: i opened a PR to align parameter names across SDKs. proposal: canonical names are `model`, `prompt`, `maxTokens`, `temperature`. legacy aliases (`model_id`, `text`, `max_tokens`) will be accepted for a 2-week migration window with a deprecation warning.
Evan: i like the window. can we also add a lint check so new docs don't reintroduce old names? a CI rule that flags `max_tokens` or `model_id` in .md and .js/.py examples.
Priya Nair: +1 on lint. i can add a docs-lint rule using a simple regex in our repo's renovate CI job. i'll draft it today.
Lina Gomez: thanks. also thinking about the user-facing phrasing in the migration note. we should avoid "breaking change" — use "deprecated alias" and show exact replacement commands. short examples only. tone: helpful, not alarmist.
Sam O'Neill: suggested example for the migration note:
```
# replace in bash
rg "model_id|max_tokens|text" -l | xargs sed -i 's/model_id/model/g; s/max_tokens/maxTokens/g; s/\btext\b/prompt/g'
```
could live in a migration-tools section.
Evan: that sed one-liner is handy but risky. add a grep preview step and a backup note. maybe show a safe two-step: preview, then replace.
Priya Nair: yes, include:
```
rg "model_id|max_tokens|\btext\b" -n
# review results, then run replacements with backup
```
and a short Windows Powershell equivalent. i'll add both to the guide.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs-style-lint job queued (priority: high).
Lina Gomez: also add a glossary entry for "canonical name" vs "alias". proposed text: "canonical name: the supported parameter name to use in examples and API calls. alias: a legacy parameter still accepted for a short migration period; will be removed after deprecation window." keep it one sentence each.
Sam O'Neill: minor styling: use sentence case for glossary terms and italicize code identifiers in examples (we can add that to docs style).
Evan: will someone audit third-party guides and partner snippets? i flagged a partner-looking example in integrations/partner-guide.md using `model_name`. might need outreach.
Priya Nair: i can run an integrations sweep after lint is in. i'll create a checklist and assign outreach to partner owners.
Lina Gomez: action items recap: 1) Priya adds lint + examples + shell/powershell snippets. 2) Sam updates glossary phrasing and style notes. 3) Evan checks partner docs and files a follow-up. 4) Lina merges the param rename PR once migration note + examples + release note are included. i'll update PR description with this list.
docs-bot: Link check finished 1 warnings, 0 errors. Files flagged: integration/partner-guide.md (contains flagged example).
Lina Gomez: thanks, will ping partner owner. targeting merge EOD Friday if no objections. feel free to drop short review comments on the PR rather than long-thread discussions. :sparkles:
